audits.label: Review of the card's five wrapped faces
audits.line: Own CPU stepper from the rule document: 57 and 75 cells confirmed; no smooth correction fits, only a kink near 61 cells; the census's 16-generation rule measured.

audits.label: Adversarial review of the dying-face study (rounds 3 and 4)
audits.line: Fresh seeds, own steppers: the dips and the company reproduce; a null model shows the lead's test for a remnant could not tell.

audits.label: Adversarial review of the state-space study
audits.line: Own vessel builder, bit-sliced enumerator and entropy sampler: the counts stand on eight more vessels; three readings corrected; a layer of the chaos is within about 1% of coin flips.

audits.label: Adversarial review of the first signals push
audits.line: Own sparse stepper and an independent search: pulses, the transmission and the parity rule stand on three codes; the line has a capacity of d − 1 pulses.

audits.label: Adversarial review of the second signals push
audits.line: Own stepper equal to the oracle: both proofs complete; the isolating gap is three layers, not two; the soup-born carriers were one-unit rings.
